name: Will Hochman
bio: Will Hochman is an actor and writer, known for Critical Thinking (2020), Let Him Go (2020) and Blue Bloods (2010).
place: Brooklyn, New York City, New York, USA

credits.title: The Cycle
credits.overview: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

credits.title: LOVE
credits.overview: A gorgeous and frequently emotional rumination on the “big things” in life, James Gallagher’s new short film, Love, poses questions on what we love, why we love it, and what happens when the desire to win becomes detrimental to our experience of ourselves and other people. credits.title: Visitors
credits.overview: A young woman in the throes of early pregnancy starts to question her own reality when strange things begin to happen to the people closest to her.

credits.title: Atrabilious
credits.overview: Atrabilious follows Steven Joyner as he tries to solve the mystery behind his son's sudden, tragic and potentially fabricated death. He is led to the titular bar, Atrabilious, and begins to unravel the history of the establishment.

credits.title: The Greatest Beer Run Ever
credits.overview: Chickie wants to support his friends fighting in Vietnam, so he does something wild—personally bring them American beer. What starts as a well-meaning journey quickly changes Chickie's life and perspective.

credits.title: Master
credits.overview: At an elite New England university built on the site of a Salem-era gallows hill, two black women strive to find their place. Navigating politics and privilege, they encounter increasingly terrifying manifestations of the school's haunted past… and present.

credits.title: Critical Thinking
credits.overview: Based on a true story from 1998, five Latino and Black teenagers from the toughest underserved ghetto in Miami fight their way into the National Chess Championship under the guidance of their unconventional but inspirational teacher.

credits.title: Let Him Go
credits.overview: Following the loss of their son, a retired sheriff and his wife leave their Montana ranch to rescue their young grandson from the clutches of a dangerous family living off the grid in the Dakotas.

credits.title: Derek DelGaudio's In & of Itself
credits.overview: Storyteller and Conceptual Magician Derek DelGaudio attempts to understand the illusory nature of identity and answer the deceptively simple question 'Who am I?'

credits.title: Sophie & Jacob
credits.overview: The story of Sophie and Jacob, two Romanian Jews who meet as refugees from the Holocaust. An attempt at keeping their light flickering.

credits.title: Paterno
credits.overview: After becoming the winningest coach in college football history, Joe Paterno is embroiled in Penn State's Jerry Sandusky sexual abuse scandal, challenging his legacy and forcing him to face questions of institutional failure regarding the victims.

credits.title: The Invisible Worm
credits.overview: The love of two young artists is put to the test when unsympathetic adults force the couple into isolation.
